description: Score a profile on one points test: Canada Express Entry CRS ('crs'), Australia SkillSelect ('au'), the German Chancenkarte ('chancenkarte') or New Zealand's Skilled Migrant Category ('nz_smc'). Returns the score, a line-by-line breakdown and the threshold to compare it with. Same logic as the calculators on transita.app. An estimate, not an official assessment.

age.description: Age in years, e.g. 29. Needed by every system.

canadian_study.description: CRS: post-secondary credential earned in Canada, e.g. 'one_or_two_year'.

canadian_work_years.description: CRS: years of skilled work in Canada, e.g. 1.

certificate_of_qualification.description: CRS: holds a Canadian trade certificate of qualification, e.g. false.

education.description: Highest completed education, e.g. 'bachelor'. Needed by every system.

first_language_clb.description: CRS: first official language level as a CLB, e.g. 9. Needed for 'crs'.

foreign_work_years.description: CRS: years of skilled work outside Canada, e.g. 3.

in_destination.description: True if the person already lives in the destination ('au' or 'nz_smc'), e.g. false.

income_usd.description: Gross yearly income in US dollars, e.g. 90000. Used by 'nz_smc'.

married.description: CRS: true if a spouse or common-law partner comes to Canada too, e.g. false.

partial_recognition.description: Chancenkarte: Germany partly recognised the qualification, e.g. false.

partner_applies.description: Chancenkarte: a spouse or partner who also qualifies applies too, e.g. false.

prior_stay.description: Chancenkarte: spent 6 months legally in Germany in the last 5 years, e.g. false.

provincial_nomination.description: CRS: holds a provincial nomination, e.g. false.

second_language_clb.description: CRS: second official language CLB, 0 for none, e.g. 5.

shortage_occupation.description: Chancenkarte: the qualification is in a German shortage occupation, e.g. true.

sibling_in_canada.description: CRS: a brother or sister lives in Canada as a citizen or permanent resident, e.g. false.

spouse_canadian_work_years.description: CRS: the spouse's years of skilled work in Canada, e.g. 0.

spouse_education.description: CRS: the spouse's highest education, e.g. 'bachelor'.

spouse_language_clb.description: CRS: the spouse's first official language CLB, e.g. 7.

work_years.description: Years of skilled work, e.g. 4. Needed for 'au' and 'chancenkarte', optional for 'nz_smc'.

name: transita_points_calculator
title: Points calculator
